From: Evan Brooks <evan@vectramotion.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — launch accelerator + pricing ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo today — the model latency and the KV cache behavior looked promising for our workload. VectraMotion wants to run a focused 3-week pilot on our autonomous logistics stack. To make the pilot high-impact and get procurement moving we are requesting a combined concession: 

- $30,000 in free inference credits applied to pilot usage
- A short-term 20% rate discount for the first 90 days contingent on a signed $200k annual commitment after pilot

We can sign a short SOW and start procurement (procurement@vectramotion.com). Tanya Li (CFO) is on the thread for budget visibility. Can you tell us if Redwood can approve that combo (credits + short-rate carveout) for a first-time pilot?

Appreciate it — Evan
Evan Brooks
Director of ML, VectraMotion

Subject: Fwd: Pilot request — launch accelerator + pricing ask

Team — forwarding VectraMotion's ask. Summary: $30k pilot credits + 20% for first 90 days if they sign a $200k ARR commit post-pilot. Pilot is 3 weeks; expected token volume is spiky (demo included).

Why I think we should consider:
- Strategic fit: they run production-critical inference in logistics (clearly cost sensitive).
- Upside: $200k ARR commitment, high likelihood to expand to additional pipelines.
- Low operational risk for a short pilot; we can set a consumption cap and prefix-caching rules.

Ask: need exec-level carveout approval for the combined concession (credits + short-rate discount). If we approve, I'll send the SOW and a DocuSign request and move procurement. Attached: my recommended offer + draft SOW.

Recommended concession (Soojins' proposal):
- $20,000 pilot credit (instead of their $30k ask)
- 15% rate discount for first 60 days after go-live if they commit to $200k ARR within 30 days of pilot completion
- SOW with milestone-based acceptance (pilot success metrics, usage ceilings)

If you need stricter guardrails (smaller credit, tighter commit window), propose now — I want to respond to Evan within the day.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: vectramotion-proposal.pdf; SOW-vectramotion-draft.docx
